institutionName: Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (HVL)

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The nature and the outdoor activity oppertunities, like climbing, hiking, camping, skiing etc.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I was very pleased with my exchange and could not have wished for anything better.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Very easy - we had a full intro week where there was plenty of information and guidence on everything

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: intro week was full of assistance and we were showed around the city and campus.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: intro week was full of assistance and we were showed around the city and campus. the student guides were really nice and good at answering questions.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was easy to register my courses because it was a package deal so it worked out very nicely.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Use mobility online and follow the steps, remeber deadlines and do it well.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Help from home university and help from host university. i found help from other students who had done it before or other students who were also aplyiing at the same time as me.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: succesful i got all the classes i wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: its easy and nice if you follow the plan and keep track of the deadlines

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The accademics where well planned by the teachers and i learned alot in a new way of more active learning.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: very much the same, but more active leraning and controlled by us students

questions.answer: Food was more expensive than i thought, the student organized trips and sport were more cheap than i thought.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: A lot of really good student organisations, with ability to take courses and learn new sports and acticities. it was all very well organized and cheap and student run.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Skiing, climbing, dancing, hiking, kayak, camping, social activities like boardgame nights, parties, concerts

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: there is a really nice Volleyball team. All kinds of utdoor activities like Skiing, climbing, dancing, hiking, kayak, camping. Also social activities boardgame nights, parties, concerts ect.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Travel around norway and visit nature sites like waterfalls mountains fjords cliffs and go artic surfing on the west coast.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was easy if you are open to being outside in all weather and join in the friluftsliv family.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Join the student orginasations at the school and keep track of activities going on. Say hi to people at the climbing wall or ask to join in on hiking or skiing.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The alkohol and party culture was different so i just stayed away from it. instead use time on being active and outside.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The friluftsliv culture. everyone respected the outside nature and used alot of time in it doing activities.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Take your time, explore nature, go along with the flow, folow your plans and dreams. Walk around town be a part of the local comunity.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bring rain clothes. buy good equiptment

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Going out in nature together with new people, pushing boudries in nature and learning new ways of thinking about sustainability and respekt for nature.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: being alone alot was a challenge and having to figure out to do with alot of time on your hands.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
